resources.string: Opens the documents people send you, without an app for each format.
PDF · images · text and logs · Markdown · CSV/TSV · JSON · source code · RTF (text only)
Word · Excel · PowerPoint · OpenDocument · HWP · HWPX, shown as PDF
No server set. These files ask before anything is uploaded.
There is no file to open.
Office and HWP files are converted to PDF by a server you run (see server/ in the project). Each file is uploaded only after you confirm it.
Only for a server on your own network. Documents and the token travel in the clear.
The server answered and accepted the token.
The address must start with https:// or http://.
Put the token in the token field, not in the address.
The address can\'t have ? or # parts.
The token can only contain letters, digits and ASCII symbols, without spaces.
That address answered, but not like a working conversion server.
That doesn\'t look like a web address.
This format is shown by converting it to PDF on a server you run. No server is set up yet.
To show “%1$s”, the whole file is sent to %2$s and comes back as a PDF. Whoever runs that server can read it.
This server uses plain HTTP, so the file is not encrypted on the way.
